Name: Smartphone
Author: HaPyke
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=6][color=#FF0000]S[/color][color=#FF9900]m[/color][color=#CBFF00]a[/color][color=#32FF00]r[/color][color=#00FF66]t[/color][color=#00FEFF]p[/color][color=#0065FF]h[/color][color=#3200FF]o[/color][color=#CC00FF]n[/color][color=#FF0098]e[/color][/size]

[size=4]Smartphone is more like a framework. It comes with base functionality that more intended to be use by other apps.[/size][/font][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]Just like your real phone. What make it fun isn't the phone itself, its all the things you can install on it.[/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]    [/center]
[center][youtube]Vagu99l2FWU[/youtube]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[left]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction and build-in apps:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Open your phone with key [b]H[/b][i] [/i]and use the magical Esc to close. Change the phone size with [b]<[/b] and [b]>[/b] buttons. All configurable in GMCM. Or you can use the interface button as well.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]AppStore: Where you can find [i][b]all (most)[/b][/i] of the apps you can install. Just like a real phone huh![/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Contacts: Instead of having to visit your friends, now just pick up the phone and call them.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Notification: Shows all of your notifications.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Camera: Functionally similar to taking a screenshot of your game. Capture the moment you like.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Photo: A gallery where you can view all the photos you have taken. You also have the ability to set them as your phone background.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Setting: Customize your phone by changing the theme, sounds, text colors, and more...[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Calendar: Well, it speaks for itself. [/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[/left]

[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48347]Messenger[/url]: Let you text and share photos with NPCs and multiplayer[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48348]Stardew Social[/url]: A social media channel for you and all the townfolks[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49000]Delivery Service[/url]: A shopping app where you can purchase from shops online.[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Casino game: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47626]Blackjack[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47513]Roulette[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47892]Chuck-A-Luck[/url] and more to come[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46250]Arcade[/url]: Stardew Valley base arcade game[/font][/color][/*]

[left][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]User Manual:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Size and position: Click and drag the edge to move the phone around. Use the hotkey or button to change the phone size[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Reorder app: Click and hold any app for 1s will activate reorder mode. And simply drag app around. To move app to another page, drag it to the phone edge. To create a group, drop an app on top of another.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Change app icon/widget/quick app: Activate reorder mode, and click on the app icon. The first click will show the widget size supported by the app, the second click will show the supported icon options, and the third click will allow you to Hide/Show or Pin app to lock screen.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Compatablility:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Mobile: Fully supported[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Split-screen: Not tested. Likely not work.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]For MODDER:[/size][/font][/color][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Smartphone is a framework and it very support custom apps. There are a lot of tools available to interact with almost everything, for example photos, widget, icon, ...[/font][/color][/*]
